seoTitle: How to Cancel Hostinger VPS, Cloud & Shared Hosting
metaDescription: Step-by-step guide to canceling a Hostinger VPS subscription and deleting cloud or shared hosting plans while stopping auto-renewal charges.
intro: Whether you're switching hosts or simply no longer need a service, letting an unused Hostinger plan auto-renew is an easy way to waste money. This guide walks through canceling VPS subscriptions and removing cloud or shared hosting plans from your dashboard, including how to stop auto-renewal for good.

steps.heading: Open your Hostinger hosting dashboard
steps.body: Sign in and locate the specific VPS, cloud, or shared hosting plan you want to cancel or delete.

steps.heading: Cancel the subscription
steps.body: Use the cancellation option for that service to stop the plan from continuing into its next billing period.

steps.heading: Turn off auto-renewal
steps.body: Disable auto-renewal so you aren't charged again automatically once the current billing cycle ends.

steps.heading: Delete the resource if needed
steps.body: If you want the hosting environment removed entirely rather than just canceled, use the delete option to clear it from your account securely.

faq.question: Will canceling my Hostinger VPS stop future charges immediately?
faq.answer: Canceling and disabling auto-renewal together is the safest way to make sure you aren't billed again.

faq.question: Can I delete shared hosting without canceling the whole account?
faq.answer: Yes, you can remove an individual shared hosting plan while keeping other services or your Hostinger account active.

faq.question: Is it safe to delete a VPS from the dashboard?
faq.answer: Yes, but make sure you no longer need any data on it first, since deleting a resource removes it securely.

faq.question: Why would I cancel a Hostinger subscription?
faq.answer: Common reasons include switching hosting providers or simply wanting to stop paying for a service you no longer use.
